concept: IAM Identity Center: Active Directory federation and permission sets
tests: How to let corporate users sign in to AWS with Active Directory credentials without separate IAM users and assign access centrally (choose two).
expected: IAM Identity Center federated with the corporate AD + permission sets assigned to directory groups. Triggers: "existing Active Directory credentials", "without per-user IAM accounts", "centrally assign access".
why_not: IAM users duplicating AD accounts defeat SSO; a shared IAM user removes individual accountability and is insecure.
